superseded_inferences: Do not infer that CDC/control-task became unresponsive after the last save solely from these Python no-response or WriteTimeout results.
Do not infer that a user power cycle failed to recover the application from after-user-restart-01: it again requested DTR=False.
Do not label chooser Finding devices with opens=0 as a successful serial open or an application protocol failure.
Do not attribute a runtime failure to deferred GC, USB suspend, endpoint close, or the appended shim from these observations.
retained_facts: Session04 really exchanged save ACKs and read-only queries through STAT before closing the native WebSerial port.
The original/v3-identical append writer verifies the new record synchronously and marks old sectors for later GC in ctl.
The original/v3-identical erase path includes IRQ masking, inter-core coordination and subsequent restoration.
PnP presence, ProblemCode0 and arrival metadata establish OS observations, not ongoing MCU task execution.
The old audit already marked hardware_cause_proven=false; this correction additionally withdraws treating the negative Python tests as evidence that an application stall occurred at all.
